[{"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/fuzz/assimp_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":43,"var":"data,dataSize","code":"importer.ReadFileFromMemory(data, dataSize, aiProcessPreset_TargetRealtime_Quality, nullptr)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are passed directly into Assimp's in-memory import path."},{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/Common/Importer.cpp","function":"Importer::ReadFileFromMemory","line":485,"var":"pBuffer,pLength","code":"dispatches the buffer to the selected importer","note":"The generic importer framework forwards the raw input to the FBX importer when the file is recognized as FBX."},{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXImporter.cpp","function":"FBXImporter::InternReadFile","line":136,"var":"contents","code":"reads the entire file into memory and tokenizes it","note":"FBX parsing begins on the attacker-controlled buffer; binary FBX input is routed to TokenizeBinary()."},{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXBinaryTokenizer.cpp","function":"ReadScope","line":344,"var":"cursor,end_offset","code":"parses a nested FBX scope and recurses for child scopes","note":"Each nested block is processed by a recursive ReadScope() call, so attacker-controlled nesting depth directly drives call-stack growth."},{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXBinaryTokenizer.cpp","function":"ReadScope","line":410,"var":"while(Offset(input, cursor) < end_offset - sentinel_block_length)","code":"ReadScope(output_tokens, input, cursor, input + end_offset - sentinel_block_length, is64bits)","note":"The recursive loop has no depth limit; a deeply nested binary FBX file repeatedly re-enters ReadScope() until the process exhausts stack space, causing the stack-overflow crash."}]
JSON
